reviewNote: Pulse Lab Pro unlocks the VS tab (Watch vs WHOOP agreement), Who to trust, 90-day and 1-year history, share cards and CSV export. Tap any lock icon (for example the VS tab or Settings › Pulse Lab Pro) to see the plans. The free 1-week trial is Apple's introductory offer; Restore and Manage Subscription are on the same screen. The one-time Lifetime unlock (com.troydunn.pulselab.pro) is offered alongside.
